observation.basis: The next measured request started 13m31s after the prior request_end; llama-benchy emits no per-context warmup events. The host stayed healthy and the server remained active.
observation.reason: A separate full-length warmup at every context doubles expensive prefill work and makes the seven-profile campaign disproportionately long without adding an independent measured replicate.

protocol_change.keep_completed_points: Retain all completed DSX points through 262144 tokens, including their per-context warmup; label that method explicitly.
protocol_change.future_points: For DSX points at 524288 and 1048418 tokens, and all remaining model profiles, issue one unscored short warmup after server readiness, then measure each requested context once with per-context warmup disabled.
protocol_change.measurement: Continue deriving client-observed prefill from actual prompt_tokens / request_first_token.ttft_s and decode from completion_tokens / request_end.decode_seconds; report wall-clock context preparation separately.
protocol_change.cache: Keep prefix/prompt cache disabled. No concurrent model servers or GPU tests.
protocol_change.comparability: Mark the warmup method per point. Rates remain exploratory n=1; points with different warmup treatment are not used for a direct superiority claim.

decision_gate: If a context size errors, exceeds the preregistered memory guard, or cannot return within the client's one-hour request timeout, record the exact blocker and continue at the next supported point without claiming a rate.
authorized_by: This is an efficiency amendment to the user's requested IA evaluation campaign; it does not change model files, production profiles, PeritoSoft, or quality scoring.
